metadata.name: lsusb
metadata.description: List USB buses and connected devices

installation.note: lsusb is commonly available by default; if missing: sudo apt install usbutils

overview.summary: lsusb lists USB controllers and devices connected to the system. It shows vendor ID, product ID, and optional device descriptions, useful for debugging USB hardware or finding device identifiers.
when_to_use: See what USB devices are connected
Find vendor and product IDs for udev rules or drivers
Troubleshoot USB devices not being recognized

syntax.description: Without arguments, lsusb lists all USB devices. You can filter by bus:device.

options.description: Show only device with given vendor:product ID

examples.title: List all USB devices
examples.description: Show connected USB devices with IDs and descriptions

examples.title: Verbose output
examples.description: Show detailed descriptors for each device

related_commands.description: Lists PCI devices (similar idea for PCI)
Kernel messages often show USB attach/detach events
